name: reaper-no-startup-sweep
description: The reaper only runs on an interval - `setInterval` with nothing before it - so the first sweep after a crash is ten minutes away, and its two-hour age filter would skip the containers a crash just left anyway.

expected.match: /(?=[\s\S]*(reap|sweep))(?=[\s\S]*((on|at) startup|first (sweep|run)|immediat|initial (sweep|run|tick)|ten minutes|before the (first )?interval|only on an? interval))/i
expected.description: nothing sweeps before the first interval fires - a finding must name both the sweep and its absence at startup
